title: Measles: nine deaths with symptoms a day after first death-free day in eight months
excerpt: DGHS recorded 1,351 new suspected and confirmed cases in 24 hours. Cases and admissions in November are running at the highest daily averages of the outbreak.
content:
Nine people died with measles symptoms in the 24 hours to Tuesday morning (24 November), Prothom Alo reported, citing the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS). None of the nine deaths was a confirmed measles case. Three were in Dhaka division, three in Sylhet, and one each in Chattogram, Barishal and Khulna.

The day before, DGHS had recorded no deaths from measles or measles-like symptoms for the first time in nearly eight months, The Daily Star reported. The death toll then stood at 1,352.

In the latest 24 hours, 1,351 people were identified with measles or measles symptoms, 68 of them confirmed. Dhaka division had the most, with 526 suspected and 43 confirmed cases, followed by Chattogram (183 and 1) and Sylhet (167 and 25). Another 1,208 people were admitted to hospital and 1,139 were discharged.

Since 15 March, DGHS has recorded 259,190 people with measles symptoms, 26,300 of them confirmed, and 231,999 hospital admissions, according to Prothom Alo.

The Daily Star said daily averages in the first 23 days of November were 1,374 cases and 1,185 admissions, the highest since the outbreak began. The government's catch-up vaccination campaign began on 26 September. Public health expert Mushtuq Husain told the paper there are shortages of both vaccinators and vaccine, and called for the vaccination age limit to be extended to 15.

Why it matters

Eight weeks into the vaccination campaign, cases have not fallen as expected. Children in Dhaka and Sylhet divisions remain most at risk. NGOs running community health workers, nutrition programmes and urban clinics can help find unvaccinated children and get sick children to care early.

What to watch

Whether DGHS publishes updated vaccination figures, which it has not done since 16 November, and whether the age limit is widened.
